_readme: Design session for the Shards of Infinity fan port — game content is NOT touched by this file.
Reopen it with Tools/CardDesigner/index.html (Open…) to keep designing.
cards.added = complete new card specs. cards.modified = per-field was -> now deltas vs the live pool.
cards.removed = cards this design cuts. keywords.* = same idea for mechanic keywords.
qty = copies in the center deck (starters: copies per player). cost null = the card is not bought.
To implement: follow the checklist in the exported Markdown brief (Export AI brief button).

text.was:
Gain 2 mastery and 2 health.
M20 Unify: gain 50 health.
text.now:
Gain 2 mastery and 5 health.
M20 Unify: gain 50 health.

text.was:
While in play: shield 3.
M20: shield 6 instead.
Exhaust, pay 3 gems: until your next turn, your shields are doubled. Killing this champion does not remove this effect.
text.now:
While in play: shield 3.
M20: shield 6 instead.
Exhaust, pay 2 gems: until your next turn, your shields are doubled. Killing this champion does not remove this effect.

text.was: Gain 1 mastery and draw a card. M15: 2 mastery and 2 cards instead. M25: 3 mastery and 3 cards instead.
text.now: Gain 1 mastery and draw a card. M15: 2 mastery and 2 cards instead. M20: 3 mastery and 3 cards instead.

text.was:
For each different faction you played this turn, gain 2 power and draw a card.
M20: gain 4 power instead of 2.
Dominion: gain 3 mastery.
text.now:
For each different faction you played this turn, gain 2 power and draw a card.
M20: gain 4 power instead of 2.

text.was:
You are unaffected by Ingeminex attacks.
When you play this champion, shuffle 30 new Ingeminex into the center deck. Once per game.
Exhaust: destroy an Ingeminex.
text.now:
You are unaffected by Ingeminex attacks.
When you play this champion, shuffle 25 new Ingeminex into the center deck. Once per game.
Exhaust: destroy an Ingeminex.

text.was:
Gain 6 power.
M20: gain 10 instead.
If you deal 10+ unprevented damage to one opponent this turn, draw 3 extra cards at end of turn.
text.now:
Gain 7 power.
M20: gain 14 instead.
If you deal 10+ unprevented damage to one opponent this turn, draw 3 extra cards at end of turn.

text.was:
Gain 2 mastery.
Return a mercenary from your discard or draw pile to your hand.
M20: return ALL of them.
text.now:
Gain 2 mastery.
Return up to two mercenary from your discard or draw pile to your hand.
M20: return ALL of them.

text.was:
M5, once per turn: choose one:
— Free: gain 3 health.
— Pay 1 gem: draw 1 card.
— Pay 2 gems: gain 3 power.
— Pay 3 gems: gain 1 mastery.
text.now:
M5, once per turn: choose one:
— Free: gain 3 health.
— Pay 1 gem: gain 2 power.
— Pay 2 gems: draw 1 card.
— Pay 3 gems: gain 1 mastery.

text.was: M5, once per turn: Scry 2 the center deck.
text.now: M5, once per turn: Scry 2 the center deck. Your next reroll this turn cost 1 gem less.
